summary: Iter 363 — Validated Home Banners CMS (admin-managed banners pilotable from CMS, with order/visibility/zone/schedule/dismiss). 17/17 backend pytest assertions pass; client + admin frontend flows validated end-to-end via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: scope_matches() with scope.state set requires the request to also pass state. Backend test for ?country=MQ&city=Fort-de-France worked ONLY when scope was created without state. If admin creates scope {country, state, city}, the frontend useHomeBanners hook must also forward state to /api/home-banners or zone-scoped banners will silently disappear in the public list. Not a blocker (default DOM-TOM scopes typed via UI normally include state) but worth a UX note.

Seed_home_banners is idempotent only by COUNT. If a future migration adds a 3rd default, the seed will not insert new defaults into existing tenants. Consider per-key upsert if you ever want to add defaults later.
promo_banners.list_public: surface defaults to 'home'; in legacy migration banners without surfaces=['home'] still work via the default ['home'] fallback. Confirmed in tests.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates TEST_-prefixed banners and cleans them up via DELETE in try/finally. One orphan banner from a pre-fix run was also deleted manually. Final DB: 2 seed banners (SB Student entry + Livraison Instantanée hero).

backend.public_list: Seed banners present (sb_student=entry, instant_delivery=hero), ordered by display_order, active-only, _id stripped
backend.admin_crud: list returns close_rate; empty title → 400; create→update (updated_at touched)→toggle (flip active)→delete; 404 on missing id
backend.zone_targeting: scope={country:MQ,city:Fort-de-France} hidden without zone, hidden on country=FR, visible on country=MQ&city=Fort-de-France
backend.scheduling: future starts_at excluded; past ends_at excluded (home_banners AND promo_banners)
backend.reorder: POST /admin/home-banners/reorder sets display_order by index, original order restored
backend.promo_banners: POST /promo-banners/{id}/dismiss returns ok; scheduling applied on public GET

frontend.client_home: data-testid=home-banner-sb_student (entry) AND home-banner-instant_delivery (hero) rendered dynamically from /api/home-banners
frontend.dismiss_persistence: home-banner-dismiss-instant_delivery hides banner; remains hidden after full page reload
frontend.regression_taxi: taxi-voir-tout link visible on home (Services Taxi grid)
frontend.admin_page: /admin/home-banners → admin-home-banners-page visible with banner cards (toggle/edit/up/down/delete data-testids all present)
frontend.admin_modal: home-banner-add-btn opens home-banner-modal with home-banner-preview live preview; home-banner-cancel closes
frontend.sidebar: CONTENU (CMS) > Écran accueil app menu item leads to /admin/home-banners (visible & active)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Home Banners CMS fully working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter363_home_banners.py reusable as regression. Only minor note: if a banner scope has a state field set, the public /api/home-banners query must include state= param (the frontend useHomeBanners hook should pass {country,state,city} together).
rca of the issue: N/A — no production bugs found this iteration.
